{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|E chu ta! That hurts!|[[Cade Skywalker]], to [[Darth Talon]]|<ref name="Legacy 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>}}
'''E chu ta''' was a rude [[Huttese]] [[List of phrases and slang/Legends|expletive]].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> It was sometimes shortened to just "chu ta".<ref name="Legacy glossary 2">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 2]]'' alien language glossary</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Oh, nice to see a familiar face.''"<br />"''E chu ta!''"<br />"''How rude!|C-3PO and E-3PO|<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] greeted fellow [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[E-3PO (Bespin)/Legends|E-3PO]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], only to receive "e chu ta" as a response.<ref name="Episode V" />

In [[137 ABY]], [[Cade Skywalker]] said it to [[Darth Talon]].<ref name="Legacy 17" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The phrase "e chu ta" was created by sound designer [[Ben Burtt]] as a [[Huttese]] expletive for the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, {{Film|V}}. According to Burtt, it is not really appropriate to translate.<ref name="GPBTG" />
